Create a detailed animation of the process of mitosis with a foolproof design. The video should start with a close-up of a cell nucleus containing chromosomes visible as coiled structures. As the cell enters prophase, show the chromosomes condensing further and the nuclear envelope breaking down, with centrosomes moving to opposite poles of the cell. In metaphase, depict the chromosomes aligning along the equatorial plate, connected by spindle fibers. Animate the transition to anaphase, where the sister chromatids separate and move towards opposite poles of the cell.
